name: EPSY 5094
title: Capstone in Secondary Transition
description: Serves as a capstone for the Transition to Adulthood graduate certificate. Provides students the opportunity to independently design and complete activities to demonstrate specific transition competencies through the creation of a portfolio. This project has been designed as a vehicle for ensuring that all students in this certificate program have mastered the teaching and administrative competencies necessary for implementing a successful secondary transition program for individuals with disabilities.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
